subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in missing-argument prompt contract for native commands, and should Telegram map that contract to ForceReply for commands such as `/btw` and `/steer`?
rationale: The implementation choice affects shared command metadata, plugin/SDK command semantics, and Telegram-specific reply correlation rather than only the Telegram send call.

options.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
options.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor, enable it for selected freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

options.title: Keep usage-only behavior
options.body: Leave bare menu taps as usage replies until maintainers choose a broader native-command prompt design.

options.title: Prototype Telegram-local prompting
options.body: Special-case a short Telegram allowlist first, accepting the risk that command behavior drifts from other native surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
recommendation.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor, enable it for selected freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a shared command/plugin boundary decision, and this user has adjacent history on that contract surface.
